book.name: Uibrani
book.title: Ubvur umbɔ aka atsɛnge abi Uibrani

content: Aka isaka asɛng ubɛn Ukugɔng Uwuku Udzowe Idɛm-Num ra akatsak na atsu unga awe asumbɔ ri itser-Num, unga awuri iyɛruwe izũwã nu idzowe idɛm-Num ri itsi arhim.
Unga idɛ̃ɛ̃ angwɛ̃dzɛn nggu abika asheri ihwihwɛng abika ayapa, ubinkutsu unga awea ru ida iker iganga.
Akɛrɛ ha atsu awu ufang unga adzowe idɛm-Num ra arhimnga, nu arhim anera ikɛi.
Unera asi ídɛ̃ɛ̃ asɛnga itsinga ri imor iyɛrɛ, bɔr awu Unum ukpekũ awuri idɛ̃ɛ̃ asɛng unga, ru nyaka unga aka asɛng Uharuna.
Rimi hã ikɛi Ukiristo asi ibeeka itsinga ikpikpoi iyiki iwe Ukugɔng Uwuku Udzowe Idɛm-Num. Bɔr awu Unum agɔr unga agɛ,
Unga abvui arherhe ra anang akɔɔ agɛ,

content.text: <<Ungo uwu uner uwuku udzowe idɛm-Num uwu ugbagbaa,
ri itɔ̃ itser iyi Unum ru nyaku Umarhkizadak.>>

content: Ri ivang Uyesu aka awe ri iyor ru upfung, unga afɛn-Num nggu iciu akpe atsotsorake nu anyĩ, afɛn uwuruwi aka amɛ̃ɛ̃ ifɔrhe unga ra akpe, agũmbɔ unga ubinkutsu unga awu uner uwuku udɔsu Unum na adzowe unga imor.
Unga awu Ungwɛ̃ Unum, bɔr unga amesi ididɔsa ru utsĩndĩ ayetnumkɛ unga aka ahwa,
unga aka amaa ihwa ayetnumnga kishoo, umbɔ atsu unga awe utsĩndĩ ififɔrh iyi ugbagbaa ru kishoo abika adɔsa unga.
Unum atsu unga awe Ukugɔng Uwuku Udzowe Idɛm-Num ri itɔ̃ itser iyi Unum ru nyaku Umarhkizadak.
Igbiir ato ri idzipu undzingri imangmang
Umɛn iwe ra abin arhɛrhɛ umɛn iki irherhe ra akɛrɛ ha, bɔr aghong umɛn iki idɛyiwa umbi agbena, ubinkutsu, umbi asi ifɛ̃rhũmbi idzursu.
Icɛrɛ imɛ̃ngge umbi awe abika umumesuwe, bɔr utsɛku icɛrɛ umbi abee unera abvui amesuwa umbi angwɛ̃rhã abina akɔɔ ra Arherhu-Num. Umbi abee abɛ̃, ubinkutsu, umbi asi ídɛ̃ɛ̃ aghambi ubingha akakũ!
Ubɛn uwuruwi abɛ̃ aka awe ubinghanga awu irheng ungwɛ̃, asi ihwɛnga imesa iyiki irhika.
Bɔr ubingha akakũ uwu ukerketakpɔ. Akakũ hã adɛ̃ɛ̃ asɛngmbɔ iyiki ize ri iyiki ibewe, ubinkutsu umbɔ ubɛn unum ani ikũ ihwihwɛngmbɔ iyiki irhika.
